components.css: .ds-proof { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 56px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 8px 16px; margin: 0; font: 400 20px/1.6 'Hanken Grotesk', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--color-ink, #0b0b0c); } .ds-proof dt { padding-top: 0.35em; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1; font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-ink-3, #6b6b74); } .ds-proof dd { margin: 0; } .ds-sub { color: var(--color-proof-ink, #a01f15); background: linear-gradient(var(--color-proof, #c8281c), var(--color-proof, #c8281c)) no-repeat 0 100% / 100% 2px; padding-bottom: 1px; animation: ds-draw 700ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) 250ms both; } .ds-ref { background: linear-gradient(var(--color-proof-light, #f2a59c), var(--color-proof-light, #f2a59c)) no-repeat 0 100% / 100% 2px; padding-bottom: 1px; animation: ds-draw 700ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) 250ms both; } .ds-del { color: var(--color-proof-ink, #a01f15); text-decoration: line-through; text-decoration-color: var(--color-proof, #c8281c); text-decoration-thickness: 1.5px; } .ds-ins { border-radius: 3px; background: var(--color-proof-soft, #fdecea); padding: 0 3px; color: var(--color-proof-ink, #a01f15); } .ds-gap { position: relative; display: inline-block; width: 9px; height: 0.9em; margin: 0 3px; vertical-align: -0.05em; } .ds-gap::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: 0; border-left: 4.5px solid transparent; border-right: 4.5px solid transparent; border-bottom: 7px solid var(--color-proof, #c8281c); } @keyframes ds-draw { from { background-size: 0% 2px; } to { background-size: 100% 2px; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-sub, .ds-ref { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
VOXELO reads like a national statistics publication that happens to be interactive. Figures sit in ruled, right-aligned tables; every number carries a small boxed provenance flag resolved in a Notes block at the foot of the page; and the one place colour appears is where the machine got a word wrong, marked like a proofreader's correction on a galley. The page is white paper and near-black ink, held inside a black top bar.

Density is moderate and editorial: generous vertical air between sections (64 to 80px), tight rhythm inside them (10px table rows, hairline dividers). Structure comes from rules, not boxes. A section begins with a full-width ink rule above its heading; lists and tables are separated by pale hairlines. Single numbers are never put in cards. Motion is almost absent: one authored animation, the proof marks drawing in under the Overview specimen.

The system rejects the dark card grid with glowing accents and stat tiles, gradients, glows and decorative animation (PRODUCT.md brand commitment).
keyCharacteristics: White ground, near-black ink, zinc greys for secondary text and rules.
One meaningful colour, proof red, used only for misrecognition: diff marks, error-rate bars, the red bar in the logo.
Amber reserved exclusively for the sample-data state.
Ink-ruled sections, hairline-ruled rows, no container boxes for content.
Superscript provenance flags (S, C) on every figure, resolved in Notes.
Tabular figures everywhere; mono only for codes, IDs and file names.

rules.name: The Proof Red Rule
rules.body: Red appears only where the AI misheard. If removing the red would not lose information about an error, the red should not be there.

rules.name: The Quarantined Amber Rule
rules.body: Amber marks sample data and nothing else. Real data never touches amber; warnings and errors use neutral notices with an icon.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` is set on body; numbers in tables are right-aligned. Never turn it off.

rules.name: The Measure Rule
rules.body: Prose is held to roughly 65ch (52ch for the hero lede, 70ch for notes).

rules.name: The Mono Means Identifier Rule
rules.body: Monospace is for codes, IDs, file names and formulas. It is never a headline, label, or decorative voice.

rules.name: The Rules Not Boxes Rule
rules.body: Group content with a ruled edge, not a card. A box is reserved for the specimen frame, controls, notices and empty states.

dos: **Do** start every section with a full-width 1px Ink rule above a 1.25rem semibold heading.
**Do** put a provenance flag on every figure drawn from sample or browser-computed data, and resolve it in Notes.
**Do** right-align numbers with tabular figures, and draw bars from zero with lengths true to value.
**Do** keep Proof Red for misrecognition and Sample Amber for sample data, nothing else.
**Do** show a selected item by focusing it (Wash, semibold) and dimming the rest to Ink 3, not by hiding the rest.
**Do** name the awaited file in an empty state (in a mono code chip).
donts: **Don't** put single numbers in cards or stat tiles; use the ruled figures strip or a ruled definition list.
**Don't** use gradients, glows, dark card grids or decorative animation.
**Don't** add shadows beyond the segment lift and the floating tooltip.
**Don't** use monospace for anything other than codes, IDs, file names and formulas.
**Don't** colour warnings or errors red or amber; red means misheard, amber means sample.
**Don't** let sample figures appear without the S flag and the sample banner.
